title: [DHCPv6] dhcpv6 packets doesn't forwarded
author: AntonHryshchuk
body:

     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
dhcpv6 packets doesn't forwarded

The suspicious changes:

https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/10486
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/10712


#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
Reproduced on simple setup which contains the 2 Hosts and 1 Switch. The Hosts are connected by one cable directly to the switch and don't connect between themselves.
HostA <-> Switch <-> HostB

**The connectivity in the provided example:**
HostA::enp4s0f0 <-> Switch::Ethernet64
HostB::enp6s0f0<-> Switch::Ethernet0

**HostA configurations:**
```
sudo ip link add link enp4s0f0 name enp4s0f0.690 type vlan id 690
sudo ip link set enp4s0f0.690 up
echo "timeout 10;" > dhclient.conf
```

**HostB configurations:**
Update the file /etc/dhcp/dhcpd6.conf:
```
default-lease-time 600;
max-lease-time 7200;
log-facility local7;

# VLAN 69
subnet6 6900::/64 {
range6 6900::129 6900::254;
}
# VLAN 690
subnet6 6900:1::/64 {
range6 6900:1::129 6900:1::254;
}
```


2. Cli configurations:
```
sudo ip link add bond0 type bond
sudo ip link set dev bond0 type bond mode 4
sudo ip link set enp6s0f0 down
sudo ip link set enp6s0f0 master bond0
sudo ip link set enp6s0f0 up
sudo ip link set bond0 up
sudo ip link add link bond0 name bond0.69 type vlan id 69
sudo ip link set bond0.69 up
sudo ip addr add 6900::2/64 dev bond0.69
sudo ip route add 6900:1::/64 via 6900::1
sed -e "s/INTERFACESv6=\"\"/INTERFACESv6=\"bond0.69\"/g" -i /etc/default/isc-dhcp-server
/etc/init.d/isc-dhcp-server restart
```

**Switch configurations:**
```
sudo config portchannel add PortChannel0002
sudo config portchannel member add PortChannel0002 Ethernet0

sudo config vlan add 69
sudo config vlan member add 69 PortChannel0002
sudo config vlan add 690
sudo config vlan member add 690 Ethernet64

sudo config interface ip add Vlan690 6900:1::1/64
sudo config interface ip add Vlan69 6900::1/64

sudo sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB HSET "DHCP_RELAY|Vlan690" "dhcpv6_servers@" "6900::2"
sudo sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB HSET "VLAN|Vlan690" "dhcpv6_servers@" "6900::2"
sudo service dhcp_relay restart

# validate the server
show dhcprelay_helper ipv6
```

#### Describe the results you received:
On the switch, the requests from the Client are not forwarded to the PortChannel member.
No answer to the request from the client (HostA):
```
hostA:~#timeout 10 dhclient -6 enp4s0f0.690 -v

Internet Systems Consortium DHCP Client 4.4.1
Copyright 2004-2018 Internet Systems Consortium.
All rights reserved.
For info, please visit https://www.isc.org/software/dhcp/

Listening on Socket/enp4s0f0.690
Sending on   Socket/enp4s0f0.690
PRC: Soliciting for leases (INIT).
XMT: Forming Solicit, 0 ms elapsed.
XMT:  X-- IA_NA a1:17:e6:fc
XMT:  | X-- Request renew in  +3600
XMT:  | X-- Request rebind in +5400
XMT: Solicit on enp4s0f0.690, interval 1020ms.
XMT: Forming Solicit, 1020 ms elapsed.
XMT:  X-- IA_NA a1:17:e6:fc
XMT:  | X-- Request renew in  +3600
XMT:  | X-- Request rebind in +5400
XMT: Solicit on enp4s0f0.690, interval 1980ms.
XMT: Forming Solicit, 3000 ms elapsed.
XMT:  X-- IA_NA a1:17:e6:fc
XMT:  | X-- Request renew in  +3600
XMT:  | X-- Request rebind in +5400
XMT: Solicit on enp4s0f0.690, interval 4090ms.
XMT: Forming Solicit, 7090 ms elapsed.
XMT:  X-- IA_NA a1:17:e6:fc
XMT:  | X-- Request renew in  +3600
XMT:  | X-- Request rebind in +5400
XMT: Solicit on enp4s0f0.690, interval 7840ms.
```


#### Describe the results you expected:
The Client got a reply: 
```
hostA~# timeout 10 dhclient -6 enp4s0f0.690 -v
Internet Systems Consortium DHCP Client 4.4.1
Copyright 2004-2018 Internet Systems Consortium.
All rights reserved.
For info, please visit https://www.isc.org/software/dhcp/

Listening on Socket/enp4s0f0.690
Sending on   Socket/enp4s0f0.690
PRC: Confirming active lease (INIT-REBOOT).
XMT: Forming Confirm, 0 ms elapsed.
XMT:  X-- IA_NA 9b:97:3a:ce
XMT:  | X-- Confirm Address 6900:1::254
XMT:  V IA_NA appended.
XMT: Confirm on enp4s0f0.690, interval 960ms.
RCV: Reply message on enp4s0f0.690 from fe80::ba59:9fff:fea9:3400.
RCV:  X-- Server ID: 00:01:00:01:2a:0b:23:a2:0c:42:a1:46:55:8a
message status code Success: "All addresses still on link."
PRC: Bound to lease 00:01:00:01:2a:0b:23:a2:0c:42:a1:46:55:8a.
```

tcpdump on the portchannel member:
```
10:09:56.069132 IP6 6900:1::1.dhcpv6-server > 6900::2.dhcpv6-server: dhcp6 relay-fwd
10:09:56.069673 IP6 6900::2.dhcpv6-server > 6900:1::1.dhcpv6-server: dhcp6 relay-reply
10:09:57.730597 IP6 6900:1::1.dhcpv6-server > 6900::2.dhcpv6-server: dhcp6 relay-fwd
10:09:57.731189 IP6 6900::2.dhcpv6-server > 6900:1::1.dhcpv6-server: dhcp6 relay-reply
```
#### Output of `show version`:

root@r-51:/home/admin# show version
